title: Silas and the Autopsy
author: Theo Whitlock
blurb: Theo Sandoval, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
